from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from service.config import Settings
from service.main import create_app

URL = "https://example.com/page"


def bulk(client, items):
    return client.post("/api/v1/urls/bulk", json={"items": items})


def test_bulk_creates_every_valid_item(client):
    r = bulk(client, [{"url": f"{URL}/{i}"} for i in range(3)])
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.json()
    assert data["created"] == 3 and data["failed"] == 0
    codes = [item["link"]["code"] for item in data["results"]]
    assert len(set(codes)) == 3
    assert client.get(f"/{codes[0]}").headers["location"] == f"{URL}/0"


def test_bulk_reports_per_item_failures_without_failing_the_batch(client):
    r = bulk(
        client,
        [
            {"url": URL, "custom_alias": "dup-alias"},
            {"url": "http://127.0.0.1/admin"},
            {"url": URL, "custom_alias": "dup-alias"},
            {"url": URL},
        ],
    )
    data = r.json()
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert [x["ok"] for x in data["results"]] == [True, False, False, True]
    assert "private" in data["results"][1]["error"]
    assert "already in use" in data["results"][2]["error"]
    assert data["created"] == 2 and data["failed"] == 2


def test_bulk_rejects_empty_and_oversized_batches(client):
    assert bulk(client, []).status_code == 422
    assert bulk(client, [{"url": URL}] * 101).status_code == 422
    assert client.post("/api/v1/urls/bulk", json={"items": [], "x": 1}).status_code == 422


def test_bulk_items_count_against_rate_limit():
    app = create_app(Settings(database_url="sqlite://", rate_limit_requests=2))
    c = TestClient(app)
    data = bulk(c, [{"url": f"{URL}/{i}"} for i in range(3)]).json()
    assert [x["ok"] for x in data["results"]] == [True, True, False]
    assert data["results"][2]["error"] == "rate limit exceeded"
    app.state.engine.dispose()

decisions.rationale: Order is part of the contract
